0022600217.text: The Wizards (4-7, 2-5 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Indiana Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, on a two-game losing streak) in the 12th game of the season for Washington. The Wizards are 10th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Southeast, while the Pacers are 12th in the East and 4.5 games back in the Central, and Washington won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on February 20. Washington will be without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Indiana will be without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with T.J. McConnell (hamstring) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision.
